name: Feeling Guilty
overview: Scripture reveals that feeling guilty stems from sin and separation from God, but true blessing comes from forgiveness and cleansing through Christ. The Psalms express a heartfelt plea for purification and restoration, emphasizing that God forgives transgressions and covers sin. Believers in Christ are assured of no condemnation and redemption through His blood, which grants forgiveness and freedom from guilt. Walking in the Spirit rather than the flesh secures this assurance, removing the burden of guilt and enabling a renewed relationship with God.
